commands: '=== sites whose bindings mention dtd or schema or disabilitybenefits ==='
$s = Get-Website | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'dtd' }; if ($s) { "name=$($s.Name) state=$($s.State) path=$($s.PhysicalPath) pool=$($s.applicationPool)" } else { 'no site named dtd' }

$p = (Get-Website | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'dtd' }).PhysicalPath; if ($p) { $p = [System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($p); "PATH=$p exists=$(Test-Path $p)"; if (Test-Path $p) { Get-ChildItem $p -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 40 | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring($p.Length) + ' (' + $_.Length + 'b)' } } }

$pp = 'IIS:\Sites\dtd'; foreach ($f in 'anonymousAuthentication','windowsAuthentication','basicAuthentication') { try { $v = (Get-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath $pp -Filter "system.webServer/security/authentication/$f" -Name enabled -ErrorAction Stop).Value; "$f=$v" } catch { "$f=?" } }
